lines: You’ve probably heard the expression, “First impressions are important.”
It means that changing your first impression is not easy.
People can see what you are like in a short time.
This happens a lot in job interviews — interviewers often decide if you’re right for the job in just a few minutes.
So your résumé may say that you are smart, but if you act shy or nervous, interviewers might not get a good impression of you.
People also decide quickly in love and dating, not just in jobs.
On a date with someone you like, small things like bad breath or messy clothes can give a bad impression.
